en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Salāt is dislike in the dyed clothes in vibrant colours’.
en.sarwar: 22. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is undesirable to perform Salah (prayer) in clothes dyed with sharply saturated colors.”’
